items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: That was a big time woman, Eloise Blackenstein.

ctx.x: No heard of Eloise Blackenstein. That was a big time woman, Eloise Blackenstein. She was a big time. Sporting house she had. Blackenstein? Eloise Blackenstein. Big time. Big time. Big time. Big time as she was.
